pin_diff.note: Functionally identical GND pin (ADJ/GND vs Adjust/Ground).
Functionally identical VOUT pin (OUTPUT vs Output).
Functionally identical VIN pin (INPUT vs Input).

parameter_matrix.note: Wider operating Vin window supports broader rail & battery chemistry headroom.
Higher Vin,abs improves survivability against hot-plug and inductive bus spikes.
Tighter Vout tolerance improves ADC reference and digital rail margin.
Actual usable continuous Iout is also bounded by package θJA thermal derating.
Lower Iq directly extends sleep-mode battery life in always-on IoT/portable rails.
Lower dropout allows regulation deeper into Li-ion / 3.7 V discharge curves.
Non-ceramic-stable LDOs oscillate with low-ESR MLCCs unless series resistance or tantalum is used.
Higher PSRR attenuates upstream switching-converter ripple on analog/RF rails.
Critical for RF VCOs, low-noise ADCs, and precision sensor excitation.
Lower θJA yields lower junction temperature rise ΔTj = (Vin - Vout) × Iout × θJA.
Keep steady-state Tj at least 15–25 °C below Tj,max for production reliability.

swap_risks: CRITICAL CAPACITOR ESR OSCILLATION RISK: AZ1117CH-3.3TRG1 is stable with low-ESR ceramic MLCCs (>= 10 µF, p.3), whereas NCP1117ST33T3G is NOT ceramic-cap stable (ESR window: 0.033–2.2 Ω (p.9)). Using an ultra-low-ESR MLCC on NCP1117ST33T3G can trigger control-loop oscillation.
BENCH VERIFICATION: Confirm thermal dissipation margin using θJA (AZ1117CH-3.3TRG1: 125 °C/W vs NCP1117ST33T3G: 160 °C/W) and worst-case ambient temperature (-20..125 °C vs 0..125 °C).
engineering_verdict: AZ1117CH-3.3TRG1 (Diodes Incorporated, SOT-223-3) and NCP1117ST33T3G (onsemi, SOT-223-3) are Level 2 Functional / Tuning Required replacements: while the footprint is physically compatible, engineering review and passive/circuit adjustments are mandatory due to ceramic output capacitor ESR stability difference. Key datasheet deltas: Iq is 4000 µA (p.7) vs 6000 µA (p.4), max output current is 800 mA (p.7) vs 1000 mA (p.3), recommended Vin,max is 15 V (p.4) vs 15 V (p.3), typical dropout is 1200 mV (p.7) vs 1070 mV (p.3), and ceramic capacitor stability is supported vs ESR-constrained. Always validate pinout orientation (TOP_VIEW p.2 vs TOP_VIEW p.1), thermal margin (θJA 125 vs 160 °C/W), and official manufacturer datasheets on hardware prototypes before production release.
